deliverables.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Lanterns Underroot Briarwake orchard TERRAIN TILE atlas for a hand-painted 2D side-scroller. ONE SQUARE image tightly divided into EXACTLY FOUR EQUAL COLUMNS and FOUR EQUAL ROWS, 16 equal square cells, no gutters or margins, full canvas used. Exactly four tiles per row, never three rows of three plus a strip. Each tile is simple moss-topped brown earth with sparse blue-gray irrigation stone and tiny embedded roots, no branches, fruit, lanterns, blossoms, plants, ruins, glows, shadows, arches or scenery. Front orthographic elevation, no perspective. Exact content reading order: row1: outer top-left solid terrain corner; top middle terrain surface; outer top-right solid terrain corner; isolated single solid terrain block. Row2: vertical left terrain wall; opaque full square interior earth/stone fill NO holes; vertical right wall; repeatable narrow ledge middle. Row3: outer bottom-left terrain corner; repeatable terrain underside; outer bottom-right terrain corner; narrow ledge left cap. Row4: narrow ledge right cap; 45-degree rising slope; 45-degree falling slope; three-step ascending terrain stairs. Solid fill reaches all connecting cell edges, never floating decorative islands inside tiles. Thin moss only on upward exposed edges. All modules fit own cell, connecting edges match, empty outside corners are genuinely alpha-zero transparent. No text, numbers, labels or drawn grid. Designed for 64px export per tile. Crisp readable game tiles, restrained painterly texture and muted green/brown/blue-gray palette. Background transparent.
review_notes: Regenerated to obtain regular 4x4 grid and remove baked orchard props. Actual source size governs crop boundaries; seams/collision topology require cleanup before Godot integration.
